attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured PAM limits (soft/hard nofile=8192, nproc=256) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified via a real login shell (su -l) that ulimit -n and ulimit -u return 8192 and 256. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the account and limits post-restart.
